D20 · Retry by failure class; audit locally
Why: transient failures may recover, policy failures will not.
Not chosen: generic retries or mandatory SaaS tracing because
they increase mutation risk and reduce local independence.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D18 · Local-first core; Fabric is optional
Why: analysis remains usable without tenant administration.
Not chosen: Fabric-first because Entra/Fabric access would
block local qualification and development.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D19 · Cloud workflow is idempotent code
Why: mutations need exact IDs and terminal states.
Not chosen: a cloud execution agent because improvised retries
can duplicate resources or claim premature success.

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Update DashboardSpec only

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

Stop automatic retries

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D16 · Deterministic validation has final authority
Why: security and schema correctness must be reproducible.
Not chosen: one LLM approving another LLM because
agreement is not evidence of correctness.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D17 · Correction loop stays inside this layer
Why: the pipeline order remains understandable and stateful.
Not chosen: graph-wide back edges because they obscure
which artifact failed and what may be changed.

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Reject unknown untrusted custom visual

Maximum 2 structured corrections
Choose visuals and narrative
Cannot edit PBIR directly

pages · positions · typed field references

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

atomic write · audit · rollback metadata

span.p:
DirectQuery default
Fresh data · smaller local artifact

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Import optional
Faster/offline · explicit refresh lifecycle

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Power BI Desktop credential store
Possible one-time sign-in
Never embed keys or tokens in PBIP

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D12 · Generate a real Power Query connection
Why: a catalog alone cannot make Desktop query BigQuery.
Not chosen: embedding credentials because PBIP is portable,
source-controlled, and not a secret store.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D13 · DirectQuery default; Import optional
Why: current data without copying the dataset.
Use Import when offline speed outweighs freshness;
the storage choice is explicit and auditable.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D14 · LLM creates DashboardSpec, not PBIR JSON
Why: a narrow typed contract can be validated and compiled.
Not chosen: free-form PBIR generation because hallucinated
schema and fields would enter source artifacts.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D15 · Immutable revisions and optimistic concurrency
Why: safe rollback and complete audit history.
Not chosen: edit active report in place because a partial
failure destroys the last known-good version.

div.style: color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Catalog and model-path input

Standard SQL · cache disabled

Discover MCP tools
Read JSON schemas dynamically

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tool registry and policy metadata
owner session · read/write class
timeout · retry class · approval requirement

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Warm multi-session dispatcher
Microsoft Modeling MCP + Custom FastMCP

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MCP elicitation → LangGraph interrupt
Exact operation shown to user

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: User explicitly approves?

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D9 · MCP remains the tool protocol
Why: dynamic discovery isolates orchestration from vendors.
Not chosen: SDK calls inside reasoning nodes because
transport, schemas, and credentials become coupled.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D10 · BigQuery extraction is deterministic code
Why: least privilege and cost limits must be reproducible.
Not chosen: an extraction agent with Google-client access
because prompts cannot enforce a security boundary.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D11 · Static checks plus BigQuery dry run
Why: lexical checks catch escapes; BigQuery resolves SQL.
Not chosen: regex-only or IAM-only protection because
application policy is narrower and SQL is not purely lexical.

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LangChain ChatModel adapter
OpenAI · Anthropic · Google
Common structured output, timeout, token budget

div.style: color: rgb(23, 37, 84) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Analyst agent
Maximum 2 correction attempts
Interpret business goal
Select metadata and fields
Propose read-only QueryPlan

div.style: color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Structured AnalysisPlan
business question · expected grain
tables/fields · filters · aggregations
required output: answer or dashboard

div.style: color: rgb(46, 16, 101) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Planning output valid
within attempt budget?

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Interrupt: NEEDS_REVIEW
Unresolved ambiguity or repeated failure

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D7 · Provider-neutral model interface
Why: one graph and one policy surface.
Not chosen: copied provider loops because fixes,
message conversion, and guardrails drift.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D8 · ReAct only for judgment
Why: ambiguity and query planning need reasoning.
Not chosen: ReAct for credentials, validation,
versioning, or publication—those paths are known.

div.style: color: rgb(46, 16, 101) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
START / RESUME
Load checkpoint and active-dashboard metadata

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Normalize request
Preserve original text
Resolve references such as current dashboard

div.style: color: rgb(46, 16, 101) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Classify intent and required authority

div.style: color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Selected route
answer · analysis · create · revise
local open · cloud publish · qualification

div.style: color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Authoritative AgentState
request and constraints
source selection and query plan
query evidence and semantic catalog
DashboardSpec and workspace version
validation, approvals, errors, artifacts

div.style: color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Context/checkpoint port
Redis adapter via injected pool
AgentState · active dashboard · approvals
Persist after external side effects

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Context policy
Store structured facts and evidence summaries
Keep raw tool payloads bounded and disposable
Send each stage only its relevant state slice

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D5 · LangGraph is the runtime
Why: explicit transitions, resume, interrupts, replay.
Not chosen: one global while-true ReAct loop because
termination and recovery become model-dependent.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D6 · Redis checkpoints side effects, not every token
Why: resume safely, coordinate workers, and prevent
duplicate queries/publications without token-by-token noise.
Not chosen: Temporal yet because its operational weight
is excessive for the single-user phase.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D6R · Structured compaction at the state boundary
Why: preserve durable evidence without replaying huge
prompts or raw tool payloads.
Not chosen: unlimited transcript growth.

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FastAPI WebSocket endpoint
Validate envelope and message size
Reject malformed input
Attach cancellation handling

div.style: color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RunContext
run_id · thread_id · user_id · correlation_id
timezone · provider · transport mode
cancellation token

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Typed event emitter
Stable UI event protocol
Redact secrets and oversized raw results

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Clean-architecture ports
ContextStore · LockService
EventPublisher · BigQueryGateway

div.style: color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Redis infrastructure adapter
One application-scoped connection pool
Checkpoint/context · locks · typed events
TTL cleanup and compact state

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Application lifespan + dependency injection
Create pool once per backend process
Inject ports into graph and services
No global Singleton state

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D3 · Backend owns execution lifetime
Why: a run must survive UI reconnects.
Not chosen: synchronous request/response because
tool calls and approvals can be long-running.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D4 · Stable typed events, not provider events
Why: the UI should not change when the model changes.
Not chosen: forwarding raw SDK streams because
OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google event shapes differ.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D3R · Redis is infrastructure, not agent logic
Why: shared checkpoints, locks, events, and cache need
process-independent storage.
Not chosen: in-memory globals because they fail on restart
or multi-worker execution.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D4R · Pool + dependency injection, not Singleton
Why: reuse connections while preserving testability,
worker isolation, lifecycle control, and replaceable adapters.
Not chosen: hidden global client state.

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 86) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Single authenticated analyst
Question · analysis · dashboard creation
revision · local open · cloud publish

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 86) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
React / Next.js console
Conversation · status · tool activity
approval modal · cancellation · artifact links

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 86) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Persistent WebSocket request
text · thread_id · optional dashboard_id
timezone · configured provider

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D1 · React remains presentation-only
Why: rich streaming and approval UX.
Not chosen: browser-owned orchestration;
refreshes and multiple tabs are not durable.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
D2 · Single-user now, identity-ready envelope
Why: harden the core workflow first.
Not chosen yet: multi-user RBAC because it
multiplies policy combinations prematurely.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
READING ORDER
Follow the thick orange handoffs from Layer 1 to Layer 10.
Blue = bounded LLM judgment · Purple = graph state/runtime
Green = deterministic code · Red = security/human authority
Cyan = verified output · Yellow = decision and rejected alternative

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
HANDOFF 1
Raw RequestEnvelope

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HANDOFF 2
Validated RunContext + injected infrastructure ports

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HANDOFF 3
Selected workflow route + durable AgentState

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HANDOFF 4
Approved structured AnalysisPlan / QueryPlan

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HANDOFF 5
QueryEvidence + SemanticModelCatalog
No credentials included

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HANDOFF 6
CandidateBundle
semantic model + DashboardSpec + compiled PBIR + base version

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HANDOFF 7
AdmissionDecision + promoted version or review evidence

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HANDOFF 8
DeliveryEvidence
local path, cloud IDs, rendered pages, or answer-only result

div.style: color: rgb(67, 20, 7) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HANDOFF 9
Sanitized RunEvidence + audit reference + disclosed boundaries
